name: io.github.nikships/ultimate-image-gen-mcp
title: Ultimate Gemini MCP
description: Image generation with Google Gemini 3.1 Flash: 512px-4K, reference images, search grounding

environmentVariables.description: Google Gemini API key (free tier at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Also accepts GOOGLE_API_KEY.
environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Directory where generated images are saved
environmentVariables.name: OUTPUT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Automatically enhance prompts with Gemini Flash before generation
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_PROMPT_ENHANCEMENT

environmentVariables.description: Enable Google Search grounding by default (real-time data like weather, events)
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_GOOGLE_SEARCH

environmentVariables.description: Max parallel requests in batch mode
environmentVariables.name: MAX_BATCH_SIZE
